title: "Edge security traffic snapshot"
description: "Read-only DNS, security settings and aggregate traffic with explicit coverage limits."
---

Captured DNS/settings 2026-10-26 13: 57: 37 +0700; traffic window **2026-10-25 13: 58: 25 GMT+7 to 2026-10-26 13: 58: 25 GMT+7**. All provider activity was GET or GraphQL read-only queries. No Finance mutation, deployment, DNS change, origin probe, or production SSH occurred. The reserved Finance WAF token was never opened.

## Coverage and limits

- Zone `tuturuuu.com` is `Pro Website` (GET zone returned HTTP 200). DNS read returned 116 total records, 55 A/AAAA/CNAME records across 55 names; five DKIM CNAME names are non-web mail-configuration records. The remaining **50 web/address names include 8 proxied hosts**. DNS-only hosts do not receive this zone's HTTP edge security today; historical proxied observations do not override current DNS state.
- Cloudflare `httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups`: **169 returned groups**, below 10000 limit, reduced to 156 sanitized UA-family/ASN/action/source groups; summed API `count` **921**. Adaptive sampling is present (`avg.sampleInterval` range 1–1.6923076923); counts are Cloudflare returned group counts, not an exact all-origin traffic census. No request paths or client IPs were queried; raw UA strings were reduced to families in memory and discarded. Twelve host strings were observed (eleven DNS names plus explicit `:443` R2 form).
- Vercel requested the same 24 h interval for 27 projects, one first page each (50 row endpoint page size). **20 projects still had `hasMoreRows=true`**; this is a retained-log **partial window**, not complete 24 h totals or complete UA/ASN distribution. A 0-row response means no rows returned for that project, not proof of no HTTP traffic. No raw request log row, path, client IP, header, customer identifier, payload, or full UA persisted. Actual available fields include `clientUserAgent` and `asnId`; absent ASN remains unknown.
- Vercel inventory-project log read timed out once (no retry); its host coverage is unknown. The other 26 project requests returned HTTP 200. Across them, 806 retained first-page rows matched tuturuuu.com hosts.
- Vercel and Cloudflare observations overlap and must not be added as a global request total. Vercel rows on DNS-only hosts were not observed by Cloudflare merely because their origin appeared in the Vercel sample. UA/ASN families are descriptive clues, never authentication or skip identity.
- Provider call budget: 40 total calls (5 initial CF reads; 6 phase/settings reads; 1 GraphQL traffic query; 1 Vercel project-list read; 27 first-page Vercel log reads). No retries, schedules, Workers invocations, or billable backend tasks were created.

The ~24-hour Vercel plan retention is task-provided context, not a newly verified account entitlement. The requested interval stays within the most recent 24 hours; pagination, absent project rows, and the inventory timeout remain explicit gaps.

## Current zone security

| Control | Observed read-only state | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browser Integrity Check | `browser_check=on`, editable | `settings.json` |
| Security level | `essentially_off` | `settings.json` |
| Legacy WAF setting | `waf=off`; this does not turn off Ruleset Engine executions below | `settings.json`, `managed-entry.json` |
| Managed WAF | Cloudflare Managed Ruleset and OWASP Core Ruleset execute with `expression=true`, enabled | `managed-entry.json` |
| Managed exceptions | Meet GET/POST skips two OWASP cookie-character rules; Meet audio-upload exception skips one OWASP anomaly rule. Exact header-bearing expression redacted from retained evidence | `managed-entry.json` |
| Custom WAF rules | Existing zone entrypoint version 2 has no rules array | `custom-entry.json` |
| Rate limit | Enabled leaked-credential block: `cf.waf.credential_check.password_leaked`, 5 requests/10 s, IP+colo, mitigation 3600 s | `ratelimit-entry.json` |
| Bot/SBFM | `sbfm_definitely_automated=allow`; verified bots allow; static-resource protection false; JS detections enabled. These returned fields do not establish a separate missing `fight_mode` field | `bot-management.json` |
| AI crawler protection | `crawler_protection=enabled`, `ai_bots_protection=block`, `ai_training=disallow`; managed robots enabled | `bot-management.json` |
| AI Labyrinth settings URL attempt | `/settings/ai_labyrinth` returned 400 Undefined zone setting; use actual bot-management crawler_protection field and observed linkMaze events rather than inventing this settings field | `ai-labyrinth.json`, `traffic24h.json` |
| Configuration rules | `http_config_settings` entrypoint 404 not present | `config-entry.json` |

The generic settings endpoint and Ruleset Engine entrypoints describe different controls. The managed executions are enabled despite legacy `waf=off`. A `link_maze_injected`/`linkMaze` analytics result is an injection observation, not by itself proof of a 403 or block. Current permissions allow these reads; this run did not test mutation acceptance or create disabled rules to discover plan capabilities.

Two additional bounded GETs at 14:16 GMT+7 read the executed managed definitions. Cloudflare Managed version 418 has 866 block and 8 vendor log rules. OWASP version 88 has 178 score rules and one block rule. Neither returned enabled challenge actions. These vendor-managed log actions do not grant custom/rate-rule log entitlement. The complete lane used **42 read-only provider requests** and no provider writes. `managed-actions.json` records the sanitized response summary.

## Reused Finance evidence

- Finance receipt the private Finance cutover receipt reports the helper Python-urllib smoke 403 and attributes BIC / Labyrinth-related events; source read only, no Finance live writes or probes in this lane. The current query separately observes Finance `block:4` from `bic` and `link_maze_injected:8`; staging `block:1` from `bic` and injection 9. Do not relabel injections as blocks.
- Current 24 h traffic confirms legitimate machine families: `Dart/mobile` on Meet realtime 27 and Finance staging 3; `Tuturuuu-Internal-API` on staging 2 and apex 3; curl family includes controlled probes. This observation does not authenticate any individual request or distinguish CIcurl from attacker curl. Source caller inventory must provide identity proofs.

## Reproduction and artifacts

The committed [inventory directory](https://github.com/tutur3u/platform/tree/main/infra/cloudflare/edge-security/inventory) contains sanitized DNS, controls, query and aggregate evidence. `cloudflare-traffic.json` includes the exact GraphQL query and time variables. `vercel-traffic.json` records the endpoint fields, paging limits and project outcomes. Private collectors and the original Finance receipt stay outside Git. No credentials or raw request rows are committed. Refresh through an authorized read-only collector with tokens in process environment or mode-600 header files. Never place a token in argv or use the Finance-reserved WAF token. No provider write is part of reproduction.

## Bounded Vercel follow-up

Window: **2026-10-25 14:23:15.598 GMT+7 to 2026-10-26 14:23:15.598 GMT+7**. Finished by 2026-10-26 14:26:01.147 GMT+7. This replaces neither the earlier snapshot nor its window; do not add overlapping counts.

This follow-up made **60 additional read-only Vercel GETs**, plus two public first-party source reads. All provider requests returned HTTP 200. No Cloudflare or Finance provider/control reads occurred, and no provider writes, purchases, deployments, or configuration changes occurred. Raw rows, full UA strings, paths, client IPs, request IDs, and payloads were never persisted. Request-ID hashes existed only in memory for uniqueness checks.

The sanitized result contains **2757 unique retained log rows**, of which **2267 matched tuturuuu.com hosts**. Across the central `platform` project, 1650 unique rows were read; 1552 matched our hosts. The central sample reaches back only to **2026-10-26 10:35:06.695 GMT+7**, leaving the older part of the requested 24-hour interval unqueried. It is explicitly partial, not a last-24-hour traffic total.

### Pagination verification

- A fixed-end `page=0` request returned 50 rows with `hasMoreRows=true`. The same window at `page=1` returned zero rows with `hasMoreRows=false`. This inconsistency prevents trusting page-number pagination here. No repeated page was blindly accumulated.
- A third request set `endDate` to one millisecond before the earliest page-0 timestamp. It returned 50 distinct IDs, all within the older requested time bound, with no ID overlap. Every later retained page passed the same bound and uniqueness checks.
- Backwards time windows provide useful additional caller evidence but do not prove complete retrieval. At least one full central page had multiple rows sharing its earliest timestamp; subtracting one millisecond can omit additional rows at that boundary. This timestamp-collision risk is preserved in `boundaryCollisionRisk`, rather than hidden behind a completeness claim.
- Six small/legacy project endpoints reported no more rows for the requested retained-log interval: `track`, `apps`, `noah`, `shortener`, `meet`, `web`. This describes the endpoint response, not proof of every HTTP request or a separately verified retention entitlement. Only `track` and `apps` among those returned matching tuturuuu.com hosts.
- No supported aggregation endpoint was found in the focused first-party CLI logs source. No undocumented SQL endpoint was invented or purchased. The maximum provider-call bound ended the high-volume central sweep.

### Sources and reproducible request shape

- [First-party Vercel CLI logs source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel/vercel/main/packages/cli/src/util/logs-v2.ts) confirms the GET request shape and `startDate`/`endDate` parameters. Observed 26 October 2026, 14:22 GMT+7.
- [Upstream Vercel pagination issue](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/issues/16286) records similar pagination limitations; our endpoint observations above are measured separately.
- The exact non-secret query shape is `GET https://vercel.com/api/logs/request-logs?projectId=<project>&ownerId=<owner>&startDate=<window-start-ms>&endDate=<cursor-ms>&page=0`. The verification-only second call used `page=1`.
- `vercel-followup.json` stores the fixed window, each call’s non-sensitive bound/count/outcome, project scope, and UA-family/ASN/status/WAF-action aggregates. `vercel_followup.py` is the private bounded collector; no raw rows or request IDs were written.
